new_today_news.headline: August 2026 QSR Trends: Traffic, Inflation Recovery, & Guest Loyalty
new_today_news.summary: Recent QSR traffic declined 1.2% year-over-year in Q2 2026 despite 2.0% net sales increase. National Restaurant Association data shows only 29% of operators reported increased customer traffic in May, marking the 15th consecutive month of net traffic decline, with growth driven by pricing rather than visitation.

new_today_news.headline: August 2026 Business Report: Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Highlights
new_today_news.summary: Publicly traded waste companies reported Q2 2026 earnings, with management commentary highlighting efficiency improvements driven by AI in pricing retention, routing optimization, and labor reduction. Retention rates remained stable across most operators.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Announces Agreement to Sell Approximately $150 Million of Production Tax Credits
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients announced an agreement to sell $150 million in production tax credits generated by its Diamond Green Diesel (DGD) joint venture under the Inflation Reduction Act. DGD produces over 1.2 billion gallons annually of renewable diesel and SAF from used cooking oil and animal fats.

recent_news.headline: Fort Worth suburb scores new sports bar from Dallas Stars owner; Shark Club opens in Northlake
recent_news.summary: Shark Club Sports Bar & Grill, a Canadian-born chain from the Dallas Stars owner, opened at 13850 Chadwick Pkwy in Northlake on August 7, 2026 inside the new Children's Health StarCenter Multisport complex.

recent_news.headline: 5 Key Waste Management Technologies in 2026
recent_news.summary: Route optimization software reducing fuel costs by 15-25% for waste management operations through advanced routing algorithms and fleet efficiency improvements.

backfill_news.headline: St. Louis restaurants: August 2026 openings and closings update
backfill_news.summary: St. Louis experienced six closures in late July and early August 2026, including two Crushed Red locations, two Salt + Smoke restaurants, and two Bailey concepts. However, 14 openings offset the closures in July, including Malo and Byte.

backfill_news.headline: Best Vacuum Trucks 2026 | Comparison & Buyer's Guide
backfill_news.summary: 2026 vacuum truck pricing guide showing new hydro excavation units range $400,000–$750,000 depending on tank sizing and chassis. Used trucks 3–5 years old typically cost 50–65% of new price.

backfill_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Q2 2026 Earnings Call: European Casings Divestiture & Nextida Asian Expansion
backfill_news.summary: Darling Ingredients signed an agreement to sell its European casings business, expected to close by end of 2026, and is expanding Nextida into the Asian market with glucose control products following successful clinical trials. Management is executing a multiyear strategic shift toward high-margin specialty products within collagen and health-ingredient segments.

backfill_news.headline: Do recent Philadelphia restaurant closings signal trouble for the industry?
backfill_news.summary: Philadelphia restaurants Hiroki, La Calaca Feliz, and the Lodge by Two Robbers have announced closures in early August 2026. Hiroki's omakase room closed August 8, though new projects are filling vacant restaurant spaces.
